t: This is the site of a planned memorial to Queen Elizabeth II, which is to be built in St James's Park. It is still in the planning phase, with no completion date set. It will also commemorate Prince Philip, Duke of Edinburgh. Elizabeth II was queen from 1952 until her death in 2022, and her reign of more than seventy years is the longest of any British monarch. Prince Philip was her consort throughout, the longest-serving royal consort in British history.
